column2: note   (WF17-cpa REPO-2: the keys a repository's OWN .git/config (and a submodule's) may hold when a CPA run works in it; read from the approved copy, S0 gate repo_config_gate in lib_safe.sh)

column1: # Every other key refuses the run (20 repo_config_not_approved): a key that names a program (core.fsmonitor, core.sshCommand, core.askPass, credential.helper, filter.*, diff.*, merge.*, gpg.*, commit.gpgSign,
# include.path, includeIf.*) or that rewrites a URL (url.*.insteadOf, url.*.pushInsteadOf) or that changes the bytes a commit holds (core.autocrlf, core.eol, core.attributesFile) decides what the run
# executes or where it pushes, and a same-uid writer of the repository could set it. A remote.*.pushurl is allowed because the project's own multi-upstream push (constitution 2.1) is built on it;
# it is judged by repo_owned: EVERY url and push url must name an own organisation.

a push url (judged by repo_owned; the multi-upstream push of 2.1)
